lifeStatusReview: Recent directly attributed interview, public appearance or reported named-person activity read alongside primary biography; not inferred only from missing death data. Coverage is selected, not a guarantee of exhaustive news through the cutoff.

birthPrecisionReview.review: Exact day supported by the browsed biographical source; conflicting or low-precision structured dates were not used.

identityEvidence.review: AI comparison of names, career and source captions; no human identity certification or facial recognition.

additionalLanguageReview.method: Every target field was authored and semantically reviewed by AI against the Chinese and frozen English dossier, then saved with reviewed-translation.save. Key/hash/intermediary validation confirms versions, not independent factual or linguistic certification.
additionalLanguageReview.limitations: AI review only; no human or native-speaker review is claimed. Licensed source captions establish the stated subject, not a biometric identity certification.
